content.problemStatement: Write a program for the coding challenge "Dice Tower". Refer to LeetCode description: https://codeforces.com/problemset/problem/1266/B
content.inputFormat: The first line contains an integer n, the number of blocks in the tower. The next line contains n integers, the heights of the blocks.
content.outputFormat: The maximum number of blocks that can be removed from the tower.
